end.summary:
Anika discussed keeping the classroom clean and safe.
They sorted examples into wet and dry waste across three attempts.
They explained that peels and leaves can become soil-like compost.
The idea that plastic belongs in compost came up and was not fully corrected by the end.
end.parentNote: Asha practised wet and dry waste sorting with Anika using everyday examples such as peels, rice, packets, bottles, and paper. Anika correctly identified several examples and described compost as forming from peels and leaves. The mix-up about plastic in compost came up again and was not fully settled; at home, ask Anika to sort five items and explain why plastic should stay out of a compost pit.
